terra.problem: “Everything else gets measured from there” adds a measuring process the passage does not describe.
The last sentence says being last in line and at the very back are different spots. Dan sets out last; the Tent travels in the middle.
Calling 603,550 “the count of the others” suggests all non-Levite Israelites were counted. The passage calls it the total of those counted in the camps.
“I like your caution” assumes why the baker chose the answer.
The explanation is flat and repetitive: its last three sentences restate that they followed everything without adding much personality or insight.
